Dr. N. Ramana
Principal
E-mail: principal.kucet®gmail.com, principal.kucet@kakatiya.ac.in Ph. No:+91-870-2970125

No,. 6S KUCE&T/2025
Dated: 18.12.2025
Call for Quotations
Sealed quotations are invited from the appropriate firms for servicing of the following
items related to Analog & Digital Communication Lab for B.Tech. IIy ear ECE, as per the
specifications given below: (For vide publish it is kept in KUCE&T website www.kucet.ac.in).
Name of the Equipment Qty
No.
1. Analog Modulation And Demodulation 4
2, Frequency Modulation And Demodulation 4
3. Sampling Theorem And Reconstruction 4
4. PAM Generation And Modulation 3
5. PWM Generation And Modulation 3
6 PPM Generation And Modulation 3
7. PCM Generation And Modulation 2
8 Delta Modulation 2
9 Amplitude Shift Keying 4
10. Phase Shift Keying 4
11. Frequency Shift Keying 4
12. Cathode Ray Oscilloscope 6
The sealed cover of quotations should reach or submit to undersigned on or before
31-12-2025.

PRINCIPAL
Terms & Conditions:
1. No TA or DA will be provided.
2. In case of malfunctioning of repaired equipment it should serviced again with free of cost with in
during ofly ear from the date of delivery of bill.
3. Include component charges individually if required.
4. Payment will be done within week time after servicing.
5. Mention clearly all the charges CGST, SGST, Transportation charges, etc., in he quotation.
